about: The bowling alley's shops (tools/bake/alley/Shops) and its street front on Bowl Lane (tools/bake/alley/StreetFront). Local to world: x = 1300 + X, y = 16.5 + Y, z = -420 - D; eye height is the floor + 5.2. Make: lune run tools/bake/main.luau; lune run tools/bake/editor_ground.luau; lune run tools/bake/attractions.luau; lune run tools/bake/backdrop.luau; lune run tools/bake/lounge_classic.luau; lune run tools/bake/bowl_lane.luau; lune run tools/review/export.luau; lune run tools/review/lounge_classic.luau --out build/review/bowl_scene.json; then /root/.cache/spicy-rodents/venv/bin/python -I tools/review/render.py --scene build/review/bowl_scene.json --views docs/renders/alley_front/views.json --out build/review/alley_front --threads 2. The renderer draws the alley's house lights but not the game's lighting: the rooms read darker than they will. The employees (Shared/Attractions/AlleyStaff) are computer-run town people, not part of the bake: 00_staff_plan.png draws their loops on the floor plan (lune run tools/review/alley_plan.luau; python3 -I tools/review/alley_plan.py --staff).

views.name: af_01_ball_shop
views.desc: The bowling ball shop from inside its door: the wall of balls, the glass case and till, the drilling bench.

views.name: af_02_shoe_desk
views.desc: The shoe rental from the lobby, over the desk: the till, the pairs, the cubbies by size behind.

views.name: af_03_shoe_cubbies
views.desc: Inside the shoe rental, from the returns window: the cubbies with their sizes, the spray bench.

views.name: af_04_gift_shop
views.desc: The gift shop from beside its lobby door: the souvenir shelves, the cash desk, a window table.

views.name: af_05_snack_kitchen
views.desc: The snack bar from the concourse, over the counter: the till, the grill and fryer under the hood, the fridge.

views.name: af_06_street_front
views.desc: The alley's front from Bowl Lane's south sidewalk: the benches, the bike rack, the planters under the windows.

views.name: af_07_bike_rack
views.desc: The bike rack and the east bench, close.
